description: This Java source file defines a utility class for computing various special functions related to the Gamma family, including log-Gamma, regularized Gamma functions, digamma, trigamma, Lanczos approximation, and Gamma function itself. It is part of the Apache Commons Math library, specifically in the 'special' package, providing mathematical functions used throughout the library.

classes.name: Gamma
classes.description: A utility class providing computation methods for Gamma-related functions, including log-Gamma, regularized Gamma functions, digamma, trigamma, and Gamma approximation.

methods.name: logGamma
methods.description: Returns the logarithm of the Gamma function for positive x, using different algorithms based on the value of x.

methods.name: regularizedGammaP
methods.description: Computes the regularized Gamma function P(a, x) via series expansion for x < a+1 and continued fraction otherwise, with default epsilon and max iterations.

methods.name: regularizedGammaQ
methods.description: Computes the regularized Gamma function Q(a, x) = 1 - P(a, x) using continued fraction when x > a+1.

methods.name: digamma
methods.description: Computes the digamma function ψ(x), the first derivative of log Gamma, using algorithms suitable for different ranges of x.

methods.name: trigamma
methods.description: Computes the trigamma function, the derivative of digamma, using asymptotic expansions for large x.

methods.name: lanczos
methods.description: Calculates the Lanczos approximation for the Gamma function, used internally for approximation.

methods.name: invGamma1pm1
methods.description: Calculates 1 / Gamma(1 + x) - 1 for -0.5 ≤ x ≤ 1.5, using a rational approximation.

methods.name: gamma
methods.description: Computes the Gamma function explicitly, using recurrence relations and the Lanczos approximation, including reflection formula for negative x.
